standaloneQa.scope: Two complete strict Viewer rounds at 6c82a9b and two at 1e2d671 (Tecos 8c12c9f): 40 files, 238/238 each, with test/tbg 4/4 after each. 1e2d671 adds only the qualification note.
standaloneQa.starterShell: SHELL.SVC 9 pages (3,584 bytes on the card); DIR, COPY and SERVICES an overlay read from its file; the pager, history, CLS and prompt from the ROM; bare names run COM, then SVC, then CMD; built-ins first
standaloneQa.bareCcp: The ROM CCP pages, keeps a 96-byte line history, clears with CLS and prompts d:LABEL>, e.g. A:SYSTEM>, with or without the shell

tas.comOriginDiagnostic: COM output selected. COM must start at 0100H.

ted.keys: F9 builds, F5 runs (a .BAS under BAZ), F1 help, F3 another file; ^T retired

keyboard.functionKeys: Fn+1-9 F1-F9, Fn+0 F10; F1-F4 ESC O P-S, F5-F10 ESC [ nn ~
keyboard.pageKeys: Fn+Up/Down/Left/Right: Page Up ESC [5~, Page Down ESC [6~, Home ESC [H, End ESC [F
keyboard.shiftArrows: Shift+arrow: ESC [1;2A-D as xterm sends it; Ctrl+arrow the plain arrow
keyboard.option: Option (Alt) with a letter sends Ctrl with it; Command is the browser's
keyboard.backTab: Shift+Tab: ESC [Z, as Shift with key 9 on the matrix and by serial; Tab alone and with Ctrl 09h
keyboard.matrix: One keyboard, as the TEC-1G has one matrix: keys typed anywhere on the page but the serial pane, the phone keyboard and the page controls are matrix keys; a held key is one press and lifts at its keyup
keyboard.ctrlLetters: Ctrl, Option or the phone keyboard’s Ctrl with a letter is that letter’s matrix key held with Ctrl, so ^C breaks and copies in TED; by serial its control code

lcdKeys: F1-F10 reach the matrix as Fn with a digit (F10 as Fn+0), whichever display was clicked
